title: Tina Mote
text:
Mathematics · Education · Leadership
        Tina Mote
        Tenured Mathematics Faculty, Triton College
        I am a mathematics educator and doctoral student. My research focuses on trauma-informed pedagogy in mathematics teaching.
        My experience spans mathematics instruction, developmental education, curriculum design, and faculty development.
      
      
        
      
    

    
      Math trauma affects a lot of students.
      
        My research brings together mathematics education and trauma-informed pedagogy within the field of higher education leadership.
        Doctoral studiesHigher Education LeadershipSam Houston State University

      Student Perspectives
      4.9 / 5Overall rating · 55 student ratings100%Would take againRate My Professor · Checked September 12, 2026
      
         “Professor Mote is a super caring person and makes math very easy to understand. She is helpful with any questions and wants you to succeed. I found her way of teaching extremely helpful especially because math can be hard to learn. If anyone isn't good at math or scared, definitely take Tina Mote as your professor...”
          “I'm not someone who is good at math, and I've always had a fear of it. But professor Mote is an excellent professor for someone like me who is intimidated by it. The problems were broken down well, and explained simply. She truly cares, and wants you to succeed.”
          “Professor Mote is an amazing teacher! She does a great job explaining and simplifying concepts so that you understand it. She genuinely cares about her students and is always there for you.”
          “Tina was seriously the best professor I have ever had. She was always responding to questions and emails right when I sent them and helped sooo much.”
